description: Deeds recorded with the NYC City Register (ACRIS) for a property: date, stated price (0 = non-market transfer), grantors, grantees, and whether the deed covers several lots. Requires one of "address", "bbl" or "bin".

address.description: NYC street address, e.g. "98 Grattan St, Brooklyn". Units (Apt 3B), borough and ZIP are optional; a 10-digit BBL or 7-digit BIN also works.

bbl.description: 10-digit BBL (borough-block-lot), e.g. "3030090016". Send it as text.

bin.description: 7-digit DOB building number (BIN), e.g. "3070696". Send it as text.

borough.description: Optional: Manhattan, Bronx, Brooklyn, Queens or Staten Island

name: get_sales_history
title: Deed / sales history (ACRIS)
